subject.title: [Bug]: Feishu streaming card full-content updates cause severe latency regression on long replies

question: Should Feishu streaming cards keep only the official full-content CardKit contract, or add an explicit opt-in append/content mode for deployments where full-content updates backlog for minutes?
rationale: The requested fix affects Feishu's transport contract and likely adds config surface; the latest live repro says cadence coalescing may not be enough, while earlier issues show suffix payloads can truncate content.

options.title: Add Opt-In Append Mode
options.body: Keep full-content updates as the default, add a documented per-account opt-in append/content mode with truncation warnings, and require live proof for both final content and latency.

options.title: Stay Full-Content Only
options.body: Reject append mode for contract safety and continue iterating on coalescing/backpressure, accepting that the latest live repro says this may not solve affected deployments.

options.title: Document Streaming-Off Workaround
options.body: Treat slow Feishu tenants as an operational limitation and document `streaming: false` or raw replies as the supported workaround without adding new payload modes.

recommendation.title: Add Opt-In Append Mode
recommendation.body: Keep full-content updates as the default, add a documented per-account opt-in append/content mode with truncation warnings, and require live proof for both final content and latency.

likelyOwner.reason: The Feishu package metadata names this handle as the community owner, and the decision is Feishu-plugin specific.
